extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (api.tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - The title page no longer keeps you waiting. The artwork and logo used to appear at once and the Play row a moment later, which on a television is the gap where you are already reaching for the remote. For a series it asked the server for the same watch progress three times over and built the whole episode grid before drawing the buttons; it now asks once and draws the buttons first. - Skip Intro and Skip Credits no longer trap the remote. While one of those buttons was showing you could not reach the progress bar or the transport controls at all, and only Back or a press of the button itself got you out. Up now goes to the progress bar and down to play/pause. - Up Next opens when the credits actually start, instead of thirty seconds before the file ends. On a film or an episode whose credits tofa has detected, that is the moment the rail is for. Skip Credits no longer appears alongside it offering the same thing a few seconds earlier; it stays for the last episode of a series, where nothing else offers to move on. - Pausing now holds the Up Next countdown. It used to keep running while the film was stopped, so a pause with the rail up could return to find the next episode already playing. It carries on from where it was when you resume. - The pause screen's synopsis keeps the bottom of its letters, and scrolls when it is too long to fit rather than stopping mid-sentence. - The title page's synopsis no longer shows the top of a fifth line it has no room for. - This version needs tofa server 0.9.31 or newer. 0.9.30 was withdrawn by tofa; its Windows update could leave a server refusing to start, and on Linux it would not install at all.
